Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Atlas demo recording + slides — quick 15-min Q&A?

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time to meet earlier today. I enjoyed learning more about Atlas Analytics’ ingestion pipeline and the bursty inference patterns you mentioned. Per our conversation, I’ve attached the recording and the slide deck so your team can share them internally.

Quick recap / next steps: 
- Recording: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c4d-atlas-demo (link attached)
- Slides: attached (atlas-demo-slides.pdf)
- Key fit: Redwood’s Dedicated pools and prefix caching would reduce your peaky token cost while meeting sub-200ms median latency for the 1–2k qps bursts.
- Open items: security checklist (SOC2 evidence), estimated monthly committed spend, and confirmation of expected peak concurrency.

If it’s helpful, I can set up a short 15-minute Q&A next week to dive into the security checklist and pricing options — Marcus (cc’d) can join on the pricing side. Do any of these slots work for your team?

- Tue, Jun 30 — 9:00–10:00 AM PT
- Wed, Jul 1 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Thu, Jul 2 — 2:00–3:00 PM PT

If timing changed, feel free to let me know and we can find something else. 

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

Hi Marissa —

Thanks — watched the recording this morning and reviewed the slides. Nice overview; the prefix caching approach looks promising for our use case. Apologies for the slow reply, we were heads down on a sprint.

We’d like to get a quick sync to cover the security checklist and high-level pricing. Can we do Wed, Jul 1 at 10:00 AM PT? I’ll invite our engineering lead (Jenna Morris) to join — she’ll want to ask about token retention and KV cache behavior. Also a quick question for Marcus: do you have a ballpark committed spend range for the Dedicated configuration you suggested?

If you can send a calendar invite for Wed 10:00 AM PT, I’ll accept and forward to Jenna.

Thanks,

Perfect — Wed Jul 1 at 10:00 AM PT works. I’ll send a 15-minute calendar invite in a minute and include Jenna if you share her email or forward after accepting.

Quick answers while the invite is en route: 
- Ballpark committed spend: for the configuration we discussed (2 x reserved GPU pools with autoscale burst) we typically see committed ranges of $15k–$30k/month depending on expected baseline qps and retention settings. Marcus will share a more specific sizing doc on the call.
- Security: we have a SOC 2 package and can provide audit logs + KMS integration details; I’ll attach the SOC2 summary and link the checklist in the invite.

Look forward to talking Wed.
